messages.subject: [statnet_help] Welcome to the "statnet" mailing list
messages.body_plain:
This is a mailing list for: 



statnet_help: Technical support for "statnet": an R Package for the 
Statistical Analysis of Networks 



The package website is http://csde.washington.edu/statnet 



If this is your first time using a mailing list, please view the 
instructions at http://www.washington.edu/computing/mailman/subscribers 



The purpose of this message board is to provide a space where questions 
and issues can be sent to the developers of "statnet". Feel free to post 
any questions that you have. 



Information about the list is available at 
https://mailman.u.washington.edu/mailman/listinfo/statnet_help 



A full list of all messages posted to this list is available at 
https://mailman.u.washington.edu/mailman/private/statnet_help 



Good luck and have fun! 



The "statnet" team



Mark S. Handcock <handcock@stat.washington.edu>

David R. Hunter <dhunter@stat.psu.edu>

Carter T. Butts <buttsc@uci.edu>

Steven M. Goodreau <goodreau@u.washington.edu>,

Martina Morris <morrism@u.washington.edu>

messages.subject: [statnet_help] What to do if you have problems installing "statnet"
messages.subject_clean: [statnet_help] What to do if you have problems installing "statnet"
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,



There have been a few instances where 'statnet' has failed to install. 
In each instance the message "unable to access index for repository" is 
returned.



I believe this is due to idiosyncrasies as we can not replicate the 
problem from computers at our end.

To find out what the specific issues are, in you have this problem, 
please run the following two commands in R:



sessionInfo()



getOption("pkgType")



Cut-and-paste the results into an email to me at 
"handcock@stat.washington.edu".

For example, I receive:



> sessionInfo()

R version 2.2.1, 2005-12-20, i386-pc-mingw32 



attached base packages:

[1] "methods"   "stats"     "graphics"  "grDevices" "utils"     
"datasets" 

[7] "base"     

> 

> getOption("pkgType")

[1] "win.binary"

> 



Best,



Mark



for the "statnet" team.



-------------------------------------------------

Mark S. Handcock

Professor of Statistics and Sociology    

Department of Statistics, C014-B Padelford Hall

University of Washington, Box 354322     Phone: (206) 221-6930

Seattle, WA 98195-4322.          FAX:   (206) 685-7419

Web: www.stat.washington.edu/~handcock

internet: handcock@stat.washington.edu

messages.subject: [statnet_help] Feedback on the "statnet" Workshop at the Sunbelt
messages.subject_clean: [statnet_help] Feedback on the "statnet" Workshop at the Sunbelt
messages.body_plain:
Hello,



It was good meeting you at the Sunbelt workshop on "statnet" last Wednesday.

We would like to make "statnet" as useful for the SNA community as it can

be.



To help us do this, please fill out the brief web survey at:



https://catalysttools.washington.edu/tools/survey/?sid=21699&owner=handcock



The results are anonymous and we will publish the aggregate results on the

email list.



If you wish to send direct (perhaps anonymous) email to the "statnet" team,

click on:



https://catalysttools.washington.edu/tools/umail/form/?i=2129&o=handcock



Cheers,



The "statnet" team



Mark S. Handcock <handcock at stat.washington.edu>

David R. Hunter <dhunter at stat.psu.edu>

Carter T. Butts <buttsc at uci.edu>

Steven M. Goodreau <goodreau at u.washington.edu>,

Martina Morris <morrism at u.washington.edu>
